context.transcript:
Joan McLean, our guest lecturer tonight, began her distinguished work as an economist right here in New York City.
She has long been recognized as an expert on Asian economic development.
Companies have come to value her thorough understanding of what it takes to do business in Beijing, Tokyo and Seoul.
Recently, Ms. McLean has given expert advice on the Chinese market, to one of the largest car manufacturers in the world.
We're very fortunate that she can speak to us tonight.
On behalf of the Dixon Research Institute, I'm pleased to welcome Joan McLean.
context.transcript_translation:
今晚的特邀讲师琼·麦克琳，她的杰出工作一直从纽约市开始，是一名经济学家。
她长期以来被公认为亚洲经济发展方面的专家。
公司们高度评价她对在北京、东京和首尔开展业务所需的深入了解。
最近，麦克琳女士曾为全球最大的汽车制造商之一就中国市场提供了专业建议。
我们非常幸运今晚能听到她的分享。
我谨代表迪克森研究所，欢迎琼·麦克琳。
